title: Parasaurolophus: Complete Overview
name: Parasaurolophus: Complete Overview
description: Parasaurolophus ("near-crested lizard") was a herbivore dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous (76-73 million years ago), reaching about 10 m. Long head crest used as a trombone-like horn. This record is the front door to the Parasaurolophus database: what it is, why it matters, and how the other records in this archive fit together.
